messages.subject: You're in
messages.text: You're in. Don't trust the welcome. Find out what the Engine eats. I will be in touch.

messages.subject: Three down
messages.text: Three tasks done. Doom is watching the Registry now. Stay quiet in the plaza and keep your answers close.

messages.subject: A region cleared
messages.text: You emptied a whole region. That is noticed. Doombots reorder their patrols when a region goes quiet. Move on before they do.

messages.subject: The cracks
messages.text: The Incursion is real. I have seen the cracks from the roof of the Embassy. Doom is not lying about the clock, which is the worst part.

messages.subject: It begins
messages.text: The second Earth is in the sky. Whatever you decide, decide soon. I will not be able to message you much longer.

messages.subject: The Camp
messages.text: You found the recording. I have listened to it forty times. I think it is what he is trying to protect.

messages.subject: Briefing, Baxter Building
messages.text: Welcome to the laboratory. I am Reed Richards. I am sorry about the mess. The blackboard holds a problem I have not solved. If you solve it, please do not tell Victor. He will want to check it.

messages.subject: On the Incursions
messages.text: The Incursions are not weapons. They are what happens when two universes get too close. Victor believes he can stop them by closing every door. I believe doors are the problem. We have both been wrong before.

messages.subject: A request
messages.text: I have a request. If you reach the Engine, do not turn it on. I cannot explain why in a message. I can only say that I have run the numbers eleven times.

messages.subject: A warning
messages.text: There is one man in Latveria who does not flinch. He may be the only one who can reason with Doom. I do not trust him. I do not trust any of us.

messages.subject: The mountain
messages.text: You reached the spire. I would tell you to leave, but you would not listen, and I would not either. Keep your answers simple. The mountain punishes cleverness.

messages.subject: The platform
messages.text: You broke the loop, or you joined it. I cannot tell. Either way, the Bureau thanks you, which it has never done before.

messages.subject: I have joined him
messages.text: I checked Victor's mathematics. They are correct. I wish they were not. I will not ask you to forgive me. I am asking you to check them yourselves.

messages.subject: A summons
messages.text: Doom has noted your progress. Doom is not often interested. Doom is interested. Continue, and Doom will continue to watch.
